title: Approved Quantity on a Quantity Limit Renewal for Acute Migraine Drugs
content:
### Determination

Under the Utilization Management Program, when a renewal request for a quantity limit authorization on an acute migraine drug — sumatriptan, whose limit is 9 units, Ubrelvy, whose limit is 16 units, or Nurtec ODT, whose limit is 8 units per rolling 30 days — is approved, the approved quantity of a quantity limit renewal on an acute migraine drug is the smaller of the quantity the undecided renewal request asks for and the renewal approval ceiling. The renewal approval ceiling is the drug's limit times three quarters (0.75) of the package's maximum exception multiple, rounded down to a whole unit.

### The drug and the request

The drug is the drug of the member's most recent renewal request. The request is the member's latest renewal request for that drug, and it is undecided while no approval, denial or withdrawal for the drug is recorded after its opening. The quantity it asks for is the quantity per rolling 30 days recorded on it.

### Ceilings in figures

| Drug (limit) | Package multiple 2.0 | Package multiple 1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| sumatriptan (9) | 9 times three quarters of 2.0 is 13.5, rounded down to 13 | 9 times three quarters of 1.5 is 10.125, rounded down to 10 |
| Ubrelvy (16) | 24 | 18 |
| Nurtec ODT (8) | 12 | 9 |

The package multiple is the maximum exception multiple the member's review package states.

### Worked determinations (hypothetical renewal requests)

1. Ubrelvy, package multiple 1.5, undecided renewal request asking 19.8: ceiling 18; approved 18.
2. sumatriptan, package multiple 2.0, undecided renewal request asking 12.5: ceiling 13; approved 12.5.
3. Nurtec ODT, package multiple 2.0, the latest renewal request already approved: it is not undecided, and there is no undecided renewal request to measure against.
